name: Taco nazo
notes: Could not confirm a genuine, currently-operating 'Taco Nazo' restaurant in San Ysidro. What I checked: (1) The official Taco Nazo chain (taconazo.com, trademarked, 'Pioneers of the Fish Taco since 1978') lists exactly 6 locations, all in LA/Orange County (Bellflower, La Habra, La Puente, South El Monte, Walnut, Santa Ana) — none in San Diego County. A rumored 'Taco Nazo Kitchen' expansion is in La Habra (149 S Beach Blvd), not San Ysidro. (2) Google Maps and Yelp searches for 'Taco Nazo'/'Tijuanazo' scoped to San Ysidro return only Tijuana, Mexico branches (Zona Centro, Playas, La Chapu, Otay neighborhoods) priced in pesos — consistent with the flag that 'Tijuanazo' (formerly TacoNazo) is a separate Tijuana-based brand, and its one US-side presence (Hillcrest) is not San Ysidro. (3) A Yelp listing named 'Taco nazo' (4.4, 18 reviews) does appear tied to the address 143 W San Ysidro Blvd, San Ysidro, CA 92173 — but that exact address and phone number (619-430-5754) currently operate as an apparently unrelated, independently-branded business called 'El negão taco shop' (its own Facebook/Instagram/TikTok, 4.8 stars/82 reviews on Google, ordering via Uber Eats/GrubHub/DoorDash). I could not find any explicit statement that El negão taco shop is a rename of a former '(El) Taco Nazo' — the shared address/phone could reflect a stale Yelp duplicate listing OR simple tenant turnover at that storefront reusing the number; either way it is not confirmed to be the same business the 'Taco nazo' record refers to. Given the ambiguity, I did not attach El negão taco shop's menu to this record, since doing so risks misattributing a different business's prices. Recommend either re-verifying this address in person/by phone, or treating 'Taco nazo' as a stale/duplicate record for removal.
